• Economic barriers: economic barriers like cultural resistance or regulatory hurdles are also one of the major problems.
• Lack of ideas: People don't think uniquely. In the generation of AI people just copy-paste everything in ChatGPT and try to cope up with that idea. In reality, we must think something different, something unique which AI cannot reciprocate.

10. There are multiple ways in which you can approach this problem. According to the case study, 68% struggled to locate classrooms only in the 1st month, 54% found printed maps confusing and 72% said they prefer mobile apps.

Step-1: Empathize: People can survey student about the problem they are facing, understand deeply about the problem and gather deep user insights.

Step-2: Define: This is a very critical step to define your problem. If we skip this step then what solution we are finding will be useless. In our case we can define the problem as confusing routes, difficulty in locating classrooms.4|Page
